tools.name: look_up_word
tools.description: Look up one Chinese word or character in the Dengdeng Chinese–English dictionary. Returns the simplified and traditional forms, tone-marked pinyin for each reading, the English meanings, the HSK 3.0 band, measure words, and, when the word has them, two example sentences with pinyin and English, an a

tools.name: search_dictionary
tools.description: Search the Dengdeng Chinese–English dictionary by pinyin (with or without tone marks, for example “xuexi” or “xué xí”), by English meaning (for example “library”), or by Chinese characters. Returns up to 10 matching words with pinyin, a short meaning, the HSK 3.0 band and the URL of each word page,

tools.name: hsk_word_list
tools.description: One page (100 words) of an HSK 3.0 vocabulary list (the 2021 standard, also called the new HSK), ordered by pinyin, with pinyin, a short English meaning and the word page URL for each word. Bands 1–6 are separate lists; 7-9 is the combined advanced band. Returns the number of pages, so ask for later

tools.name: get_embed_code
tools.description: Get the HTML code to put a free Dengdeng dictionary widget on a website, for example a teacher's class page or a blog.
